claim: The circulating statistic that 73% of creators quit in their first year appears in this source as a bare opening assertion with no citation, no sample size, no year, no platform and no country, and no primary study for it is identifiable from the source chain.
stance_target: The evidentiary standing of the widely repeated claim that 73% of creators quit within a year
scope_conditions: BerryViral SEO article, undated and unbylined, promoting the publisher's own thumbnail tool; the only outbound citation on the page points to a Teachable marketing blog about profitable niches, which is unrelated to the attrition figure
quoted_support: 73% of creators quit in their first year. It isn't because they lack talent or the algorithm hates them.
